621111.headline: For physician offices the model ties population: 78660, Pflugerville leads, but only by a little.
621111.sub: Clinics follow households, not offices. The ranking is shown, not hidden — and it is no better than picking the fastest-growing suburb by population.

713940.headline: Branch 4 goes to 78704, South Austin — where demand for gyms is growing fastest.
713940.sub: Young professionals and a dense office base pull new gyms in. Your own branches add the rest: weekday evenings are where you win, and 78704 is full of them.

722515.headline: Coffee follows foot traffic: 78701, Downtown ranks first, with East Austin close behind.
722515.sub: Office density and walkable blocks pull new cafés in. Suburban ZIPs that lead for gyms fall back here.
